test_title: PYST 58: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language, ‘DICE’ is written as ‘EKFI’ and ‘PLAN’ is written as ‘QNDR’.

How will ‘LUDO’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30dbf680205b2ac5ef3c42da1ffec8619642030da36e21c43297a3224c70e079.png] 

**DICE: EKFI**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f62d581afdb5fd22d06aea36b02905bb540c3c7498c014ff37b0e5efb6b772a5.png] 

**PLAN: QNDR**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ecb515696b3d9b00a01351053fc8eb8d432303908c855a6964826a5cb983b04.png] 

Similarly,

**LUDO: ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/077909a4e70816cd89e4bff6a2ae98859aaf5be37afb1d849a8f1763ab2842d8.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"MWGS"**.
